title: From Paris With Love
description: A low-ranking agent (Jonathan Rhys Meyers) joins forces with a trigger-happy operative (John Travolta) to stop a terrorist attack in France.

title: The Courier
description: A courier in London discovers that one of the packages she's transporting is a bomb.

title: Legacy of Lies
description: A former MI6 agent teams up with a Ukrainian journalist to uncover the truth behind Russian covert operations.

title: MI-5: The Greater Good
description: A former MI5 agent (Peter Firth) investigates the disappearance of Harry Pearce (Kit Harington) when the operative is blamed for the escape of a ruthless terrorist (Elyes Gabel).

title: Law Abiding Citizen
description: Ten years after his wife and child die in a home invasion, a man carries out an elaborate plot against the prosecutor who cut a deal with one of the killers.

title: Line of Duty
description: A disgraced cop teams up with a livestreaming news broadcaster to try and save the police chief's kidnapped daughter.

title: Patriots Day
description: In the aftermath of the Boston Marathon bombings, police Sgt. Tommy Saunders, FBI Special Agent Richard DesLauriers and Commissioner Ed Davis join survivors, first responders and other investigators in a race against time to find the suspects.

title: Righteous Kill
description: Two veteran detectives hunt a vigilante whose crimes resemble those of a killer they put behind bars long ago.

title: Stand Up Guys
description: A geriatric gangster's (Al Pacino) release from prison leads to a reunion with his two partners in crime (Christopher Walken, Alan Arkin), one of whom has orders to kill him.

title: Killing Them Softly
description: After a rival crook hires a pair of bumbling thieves (Scoot McNairy, Ben Mendelsohn) to rob their card game, mobsters hire a reluctant hit man (Brad Pitt) to settle the score.

title: Inglourious Basterds
description: An Allied officer (Brad Pitt) and his team of Jewish soldiers join forces with a German actress and undercover agent to take down the leaders of the Third Reich.

title: Django Unchained
description: A former slave (Jamie Foxx) joins forces with the German bounty hunter (Christoph Waltz) who freed him and helps hunt down the South's most-wanted criminals, all in the hope of finding his long-lost wife (Kerry Washington).

title: The Hateful Eight
description: While seeking shelter from a blizzard in post-Civil War Wyoming, two bounty hunters (Samuel L. Jackson, Kurt Russell), a fugitive prisoner (Jennifer Jason Leigh) and a man (Walton Goggins) who claims to be a sheriff encounter four strangers.
